trial_court: Family Court-cum-V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Visakhapatnam (F.C.O.P.No.2182 of 2024)
case_name: Korikeni Kovvada Ramalakshmi vs Korikeni Manikanta
facts_of_case: Petitioner is wife of respondent/husband, residing separately due to matrimonial disputes; respondent filed F.C.O.P.No.2182 of 2024 seeking nullity of marriage; petitioner seeks transfer of case from Visakhapatnam to Amaravati.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to transfer a case to establish that it is not possible for them to attend the proceedings without undue hardship.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and for the reasons mentioned in the accompanying affidavit, there shall be an Interim Stay of all further proceedings including the appearance of the petitioner herein

outcome.final_order: Interim Stay of all further proceedings in F.C.O.P.No.2182 of 2024 till 09.04.2025; notice to respondent and post matter on 09.04.2025.

keywords: Family Court-cum-V Additional District and Sessions Judge
